title: Remoting exceptions during test execution

milestone.description:
In the 3.4 release, we plan to improve the engine to allow it to run tests targeting platforms and .NET frameworks that are currently only supported through NUnitLite based runners. This includes platforms like .NET Core and Universal Windows. Ideally, this will also improve the way we run tests on mobile platforms like Android and iOS.

Since these features will be a part of the engine, any runners using the engine will automatically support the new platforms.

In addition, we will be fixing issues and completing enhancements in the backlog in priority order.

We are planning on maintaining a quarterly release cycle and plan on releasing 3.4 at the end of June.

body:
In the process of migrating from NUnit 2.6 to 3.2.1 I repeatedly run into errors with tests that fail to report the result during the execution, and the internal trace files of the test run fills up with remoting exceptions similar to this on:

> System.Runtime.Remoting.RemotingException: Object '/4f1134d2_f841_416d_b1a9_a0a78447fc4a/upwuhw+18ooxwlbxdcaourel_1.rem' has been disconnected or does not exist at the server.
> 
> Server stack trace: 
>    at System.Runtime.Remoting.Channels.ChannelServices.CheckDisconnectedOrCreateWellKnownObject(IMessage msg)
>    at System.Runtime.Remoting.Channels.ChannelServices.DispatchMessage(IServerChannelSinkStack sinkStack, IMessage msg, IMessage& replyMsg)
> 
> Exception rethrown at [0]: 
>    at System.Runtime.Remoting.Proxies.RealProxy.HandleReturnMessage(IMessage reqMsg, IMessage retMsg)
>    at System.Runtime.Remoting.Proxies.RealProxy.PrivateInvoke(MessageData& msgData, Int32 type)
>    at NUnit.Engine.ITestEventListener.OnTestEvent(String report)
>    at NUnit.Engine.RunTestsCallbackHandler.ReportProgress(String state)
>    at NUnit.Engine.CallbackHandler.RaiseCallbackEvent(String eventArgument)
>    at System.Runtime.Remoting.Messaging.StackBuilderSink._PrivateProcessMessage(IntPtr md, Object[] args, Object server, Object[]& outArgs)
>    at System.Runtime.Remoting.Messaging.StackBuilderSink.SyncProcessMessage(IMessage msg)
> 
> Exception rethrown at [1]: 
>    at System.Runtime.Remoting.Proxies.RealProxy.HandleReturnMessage(IMessage reqMsg, IMessage retMsg)
>    at System.Runtime.Remoting.Proxies.RealProxy.PrivateInvoke(MessageData& msgData, Int32 type)
>    at System.Web.UI.ICallbackEventHandler.RaiseCallbackEvent(String eventArgument)
>    at NUnit.Framework.Internal.TestProgressReporter.TestFinished(ITestResult result)

After the first such exception no further similar exceptions are reported. It seems to occur whenever a test takes "long" time to report progress, which usually happens for us when there is some errors in the test. However finding the errors is challenging when the result is not reported. Any tests that has not completed before the first error fails to report status to TeamCity, so it looks as if the that is missing rather than not executed at all/executed with failure.

Full trace of a failed test execution:
[remoting-error.txt](https://github.com/nunit/nunit/files/253803/remoting-error.txt)
